# userFunctionTimerTest.py

You can view and download this file on Github: [userFunctionTimerTest.py](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/tree/master/python/TestModels/userFunctionTimerTest.py)

```{code-block} python
:linenos:

#+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
# This is an EXUDYN example
#
# Details:  The solver timer userFunctions (#2007): with simulationSettings.show.computationTime, the solver measures
#           the time spent in the user functions of items and of the system - here a spring-damper with a Python
#           force and a preStep function - and lists it under the CPU-time statistics; a model without user
#           functions has zero there, and without computationTime nothing is measured. Only the flags are tested,
#           as times differ from run to run.
#
# Author:   Johannes Gerstmayr
# Date:     2026-10-13
#
# Copyright:This file is part of Exudyn. Exudyn is free software. You can redistribute it and/or modify it under the terms of the Exudyn license. See 'LICENSE.txt' for more details.
#
#+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

import exudyn as exu
from exudyn.utilities import * #includes itemInterface and rigidBodyUtilities

SC = exu.SystemContainer()

def Model(withUserFunctions):
    mbs = SC.AddSystem()
    oGround = mbs.CreateGround()
    body = mbs.CreateMassPoint(referencePosition=[1, 0, 0], mass=1)
    def UFforce(mbs, t, itemNumber, deltaL, deltaL_t, stiffness, damping, force):
        return stiffness*deltaL + damping*deltaL_t
    mbs.CreateSpringDamper(itemNumbers=[oGround, body], stiffness=100, damping=1,
                           springForceUserFunction=UFforce if withUserFunctions else 0)
    if withUserFunctions:
        mbs.SetPreStepUserFunction(lambda mbs, t: True)
    mbs.Assemble()
    return mbs

def UserFunctionTime(withUserFunctions, computationTime):
    mbs = Model(withUserFunctions)
    simulationSettings = exu.SimulationSettings()
    simulationSettings.timeIntegration.numberOfSteps = 200
    simulationSettings.timeIntegration.endTime = 0.2
    simulationSettings.timeIntegration.verboseMode = 0
    simulationSettings.solution.file.write = False
    simulationSettings.show.computationTime = computationTime
    mbs.SolveDynamic(simulationSettings)
    timer = mbs.sys['dynamicSolver'].timer
    return (timer.userFunctions, timer.total)

checks = []
(time, total) = UserFunctionTime(True, True)
checks.append(('measured with user functions', 0 < time < total))
(time, total) = UserFunctionTime(False, True)
checks.append(('zero without user functions', time == 0))
(time, total) = UserFunctionTime(True, False)
checks.append(('not measured without computationTime', time == 0))

for (name, passed) in checks:
    exu.Print(name + ':', passed)
u = sum(passed for (name, passed) in checks)
exu.Print('solution of userFunctionTimerTest=', u)

exu.sys['testResult'] = u
```
